_install_instructions: templates/codex-hooks.json — User-installed Codex lifecycle hook template (two-step install).
STEP 1. Locate your Cerberus install root — the directory containing bin/, skills/,
.codex-plugin/, etc. (e.g. ~/code/cerberus, /opt/cerberus).
STEP 2. Replace EVERY occurrence of the placeholder <CERBERUS_INSTALL_ROOT> below
with the absolute path to that install root, then copy the resulting JSON
into Codex's hooks configuration file (typically ~/.codex/hooks.json or
the platform equivalent — see docs/CODEX.md §Configure Hooks for the exact
target path).
Example (POSIX shell):
sed 's|<CERBERUS_INSTALL_ROOT>|/Users/me/code/cerberus|g' \
templates/codex-hooks.json > ~/.codex/hooks.json
Alternative: users who set CERBERUS_ROOT in their shell profile may instead
replace the placeholder with ${CERBERUS_ROOT} and rely on env-var expansion
at hook-invocation time (Codex's hook runner expands shell-style variables
in the same way Claude's runner expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}). The shared
backend reads CERBERUS_ROOT first via __cerberus_resolve_root, so this path
is supported without further changes.
OQ-2 RESOLUTION (docs/CODEX.md §Phase 1 Spike Findings, 2026-04-30): no stable
Codex-provided env var equivalent to Claude's CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is documented as
of authoring. The placeholder approach is the documented fallback. If a future
Codex release ships a stable env var (e.g. CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT), update this template
to default to ${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT} and demote the placeholder to fallback.
This template registers SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit to keep the Codex
active-session registry fresh, plus Stop to enforce the review gate.
Claude-only team-automation lifecycle hooks are deferred to Phase 4 and are
not wired up here.
